title.narrative: Capacity Building Programme on Social Accountability and Social Activism (Youth Act)

description.narrative: The general objective of this project is to promote social accountability and the safe participation of young activists in democratic life and in the fight against corruption, promoting a culture of transparency and accountability. Specific objectives include, 1) train young activists in Latin America in democratic culture and in research and social auditing methodologies, with a practical and advocacy approach, so that they can demand accountability and safely influence public affairs in their communities; and 2) promote the exchange of experiences, interaction and collaboration among young activists committed to public life, transparency and accountability, by supporting them in their research and using educational tools that allow them to transfer the knowledge they have learned to their peers or partners in their communities.COUNTRIES INVOLVED ARE:Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Peru, Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Venezuela, Panama, Costa Rica, Honduras, Guatemala, Mexico, Dominican Republic. VALUE OF THE CONTRACT IS EUR 275,000.

participating-org.narrative: Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID)

recipient-region.narrative: The countries involved are: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Peru, Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Venezuela, Panama, Costa Rica, Honduras, Guatemala, Mexico, and the Dominican Republic.
